# Rajav Beach Resort Cherai

[Rajav Beach Resort Cherai](https://www.rajavbeachresort.com/) is a premium coastal luxury getaway located in Cherai, near Kochi, Kerala. It offers a blend of natural beauty, refined elegance, and modern luxury facilities.

## Pages and Resources
- [Homepage](https://www.rajavbeachresort.com/) - Main entry point with details about the resort, direct beach access, infinity pool, amenities, guest reviews, and booking widget.
- [Rooms & Suites](https://www.rajavbeachresort.com/rooms) - Overview of all 5 available room types (Premium Jacuzzi Room, Premium Beach View Room, Balcony Room, Economy Room, and Entire Resort booking buyout).
- [Complete Your Booking](https://www.rajavbeachresort.com/book-now) - Booking page to check calendar availability, select dates, choose rooms, and finalize resort reservations.
- [Premium Jacuzzi Room](https://www.rajavbeachresort.com/jacuzzi-room) - Detailed features and booking option for our signature room with a private warm-water jacuzzi and beachfront views.
- [Entire Resort Booking](https://www.rajavbeachresort.com/entire-resort-booking) - Dedicated details page for booking the entire resort exclusively (buyout) for corporate outings, family reunions, and intimate weddings.

## Key Features
- **Infinity Pool**: Stunning views overlooking the Arabian Sea.
- **Direct Beach Access**: Seamless entry to the pristine sands of Cherai Beach.
- **Accommodation Options**:
    - **Premium Jacuzzi Suites**: Luxury room featuring a private jacuzzi and ocean view.
    - **Premium Beach View Rooms**: Beachfront room with panoramic sea views.
    - **Medium Balcony Rooms**: Stays with a private balcony overlooking the scenic streetscape.
    - **Economy Rooms**: Cozy, budget-friendly luxury with full resort access.
- **Amenities**: High-speed WiFi, infinity pool, complimentary breakfast, secure gated parking, and dedicated service staff.
